env.tooOld: Version {version} is too old: Duolo needs {minimum} or later. Update it with the install command.
task.commitMessage: Save uncommitted changes (task closed in Duolo)
task.leftAt: The working directory is no longer a git worktree, so it was left at {path}.
task.writer: {agent} is doing this task. Click to hand it to another agent
task.switchWriterBody: {from} will stop and {to} will continue in the same folder. {to} gets the requirement and the recent conversation, and looks at the current changes first.
task.switchBackBody: {from} will stop and {to} will pick up its earlier conversation in this task. {to} is told what was said and changed while it was away.
review.buttonTitle: Pick an agent to review this task's changes in the background, read-only. ⌘⇧R asks {agent} again
review.runningNote: {reviewer} is reading every change on {branch} relative to {base}, read-only. This usually takes a minute or two; keep working with {writer} meanwhile.
review.handoff: Please address the following code review (a read-only review by {agent}):
review.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the changes to review them: {detail}
voice.title: Voice input (hold {key})
voice.needTask: Open a task first, then use voice input.
confirm.closeBody: This stops the task's agents and deletes its working directory. Uncommitted changes are committed to branch {branch} first. Files ignored by git, such as .env, are deleted.
notice.title: Something needs your attention
confirm.quitBody: {count} agents are still running and will be stopped. You can resume their sessions next time.
confirm.quitHideHint: To just hide the window, use ⌘W.
quit.notResponding: Duolo isn't responding. Quit anyway? Running agents will be stopped; you can resume their sessions next time.
error.notGitRepo: {path} is not inside a git repository. Choose a folder in a git repo.
error.gitMissing: git isn't installed or isn't on your PATH.
error.commandNotFound: Couldn't start {program}. Make sure it's installed and on your PATH.
error.voiceNotConfigured: Voice input needs a Duolo server. Set server in ~/.duolo/config.toml.
error.voicePermission: Duolo needs microphone access. Allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security, then try again.
error.voiceOffline: Can't reach the Duolo server, so voice input isn't available. Check your connection and try again.
error.voiceQuotaExceeded: You've used up today's voice input. It resets tomorrow.
error.voiceUnavailable: Voice recognition isn't available on the server right now. Try again later.
error.reviewNotConfigured: No review command is configured (review_command in ~/.duolo/config.toml).
error.unknownAgent: There's no agent named “{kind}”. Agents come from plugins (built in, or in ~/.duolo/agents/) and from [agents.{kind}] in ~/.duolo/config.toml.
error.pathExists: {path} already exists. Remove it or choose another name.
error.invalidCloneUrl: “{url}” isn't a git URL. Paste an address like https://github.com/owner/repo.git.
error.notAFolder: “{path}” isn't a usable folder name or folder.
error.noRepository: This project has no git repository yet. Create one first.
error.nestedRepo: {path} is a separate git repository inside this task, so its contents can't be saved automatically. Move it out of the task (if it's a submodule, commit and push its changes), then close the task again.
error.stillChanging: Files in {path} are still being changed, probably by a process the agent started. Stop it, then close the task again.
error.folderInUse: Another program is using {path}. Close it (a terminal, an editor, or a program the agent started), then close the task again.
error.saveChangesFailed: Couldn't save the uncommitted changes, so the task was kept: {detail}
error.stateRestored: Duolo's data file was damaged and has been restored from its backup. The damaged file was kept at {path}.
error.stateReset: Duolo's data file was damaged and there is no usable backup, so the project list is empty. Your code, branches and working directories are untouched. The damaged file was kept at {path}.
error.configInvalid: {path} has a mistake, so Duolo is using the default settings for now. Fix it and restart Duolo. Details: {detail}
error.agentPluginInvalid: The agent plugin {path} has a mistake and was skipped. Fix it and restart Duolo. Details: {detail}
error.invalidBranch: “{name}” can't be a branch name. Use letters, numbers, - and /, without spaces.
error.branchExists: Branch “{name}” already exists. Pick another name.
error.promptChanged: The agent is no longer waiting for this. Check what it's asking now.
error.commandExpired: This reached your computer too late, so it wasn't carried out.
error.badPairingLink: This isn't a Duolo pairing code. Scan the one shown on your computer.
error.invalidPairingCode: This code has expired or was already used. Show a new one on your computer.
error.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.server: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.
error.unauthorized: This phone is no longer connected. Scan the code on your computer again.
error.computerOffline: Your computer is offline, so this can't be done right now.
error.storage: Couldn't save on this phone. Free up some space and try again.
macos.microphoneUsage: Duolo uses the microphone for voice input.
cli.about: A local-first AI coding workbench: Claude writes, Codex reviews
cli.help.path: Open Duolo; a git repository is added as a project (default: current directory)
cli.help.tui: Open the workbench in the terminal (handy over SSH)
cli.help.new: Create a task; its agent starts when you open it
cli.help.project: Project id (default: the repository of the current directory)
cli.help.writer: Agent that writes the code, e.g. claude or codex (default: from config.toml)
cli.help.switch: Change who writes or reviews a task
cli.help.switchWriter: Agent that takes over writing the code, e.g. codex
cli.help.switchReviewer: Agent that reviews from now on
cli.writerSwitched: Task #{id}: {agent} writes the code from now on. It starts once the task is open in Duolo.
cli.appNotFound: Duolo.app not found, opening in the terminal instead. See the README to install the desktop app.
cli.noSuchProject: No project {id}. Run duolo ls to list projects.
cli.taskHint: Open it in Duolo and its agent starts automatically.
cli.noTasks: No tasks yet. Create one with duolo new or press ⌘N in Duolo.
cli.doctor.voiceHint: Voice input uses the Duolo server. To turn it on, set server in {path}.
cli.badArgs: Can't understand “{arg}”. Run duolo --help to see usage.
cli.missingArgs: Something is missing: {arg}. Run duolo --help to see usage.
tui.addProjectBody2: Type a repository path below, or run duolo from inside a repository.
tui.homeTitle: What should the agent do today?
tui.homeBody: Duolo opens a new worktree where {writer} writes the code and {reviewer} reviews it when you ask.
tui.promptPlaceholder: Describe what to do, e.g. add paging and filters to the order list
tui.scrolledBack: Scrolled back · press any key to return
tui.confirmClose: Close “{title}”? Uncommitted changes are committed first.
tui.confirmQuit: Agents are still running and will be stopped (you can resume them later).
tui.needsYou: The agent needs you; answer it above
tui.projectAdded: Added project {id}. You can create a task now.
tui.taskClosed: Task closed; its branch is kept
tui.help.title: Shortcuts
tui.help.voice: voice input; press again to stop
tui.help.mouseOpen: open a task or agent in the sidebar
settings.title: Settings
settings.fnConflict: The 🌐 key also opens emoji or switches input. Set “Press 🌐 key to” to “Do Nothing”.
newTask.placeholder: What should {agent} do? Press ↵ with nothing to start a blank task
newTask.noAgent: No coding agent is installed. Install one of these, then check again.
newTask.noRepoHint: This folder has no git repository yet.
newTask.initFolder: Make this folder a git repository
newTask.newBranchTitle: New branch for this task. AI names it from your request; click to change it.
welcome.title: Pick a repository to start
welcome.body: Each task gets its own branch and working folder. Claude writes, Codex reviews, and your checkout stays untouched.
addProject.title: Add Project
addProject.chooseLocation: Choose where to create the folder
email.codeBody:
Your Duolo sign-in code is {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.

If you didn't try to sign in, you can ignore this email.
mobile.empty.hint: Start a task here and it runs on your computer.
mobile.menu.title: Menu
mobile.steps.title: Progress
mobile.prompt.title: {agent} is waiting for you
mobile.prompt.unreadable: Answer this one on your computer.
mobile.banner.offline: Your computer is offline. Messages are delivered when it's back.
mobile.banner.unlinked: This phone was disconnected. Scan the code again to reconnect.
mobile.new.queued: It starts when your computer is back online.
mobile.pair.title: Connect your computer
mobile.pair.body: On your computer, open Duolo, choose “Connect a Phone” in Settings, then scan the code.
mobile.pair.privacy: End-to-end encrypted. The server can't see your code or conversations.
mobile.pair.camera: Allow camera access in Settings to scan the code.
mobile.voice.hint: Hold to talk, release to send
mobile.voice.permission: Allow the microphone in Settings to talk to Duolo.
mobile.settings.disconnectBody: This phone forgets its tasks and messages. Nothing on your computer changes.
mobile.perm.camera: Duolo uses the camera to scan the code shown on your computer.
mobile.perm.microphone: Duolo uses the microphone so you can talk to your coding agents.
error.chatUnsupported: This agent can't run in chat mode.
task.surfaceChat: Chat: talk to {agent} here, same session
task.surfaceBusyBody: {agent} is working on something. Switching restarts it in the other view and interrupts what it's doing now; the conversation continues.
tui.chatMode: {agent} is running in chat mode · open this task in the Duolo app, or switch it to the terminal there
